socialBoxComparison.mechanism: Group URL API resolves exact source aliases to private directories beneath OS clone home; no original entitlements or fallback; component-by-component no-symlink traversal.
socialBoxComparison.surface: Four declared App Group filesystem containers
socialBoxComparison.verification: 42 real filesystem checks on Mac and iPhone; actual group URL interception included in 97-check device probe. Separate OS clone homes still need actual paired-app acceptance. Actual A/B clones resolve and read their own four private groups after FSOWN-001. However public file reads and stat reach the sibling OS home (DEVISO-001), invalidating reliance on that home as an enforced boundary on this device.

interferenceRisks: Both products can intercept Security, CFPreferences, UIDevice/MG/IOKit and clipboard paths. Hook order and original-pointer chaining can apply double transforms or permit unexpected fallback; test one product at a time before any coexistence trial.

SocialBox injects system services and Preferences/SpringBoard/runningboardd, outside SocialBox clone processes. Enabling it on the same phone can change the environment of SocialBox acceptance even when the clone bundle is absent from its app filter.

Service global state, thread-local request attribution, PID caches and activeContainer lookups require process-lifetime and concurrency binding; references here are insufficient to prove race-free A/B switching.

securityd entitlement-response changes and sandbox-extension issuance can change effective access, not merely report synthetic identifiers. Port only with a narrow reviewed authority contract and direct-syscall foreign-data tests.
limitations: Pseudocode is reconstructed, obfuscated, and has unresolved indirect calls/type/control-flow warnings. Addresses and function-index status are provided for reproduction; static registration does not prove successful installation or behavior.
The name-based authentication omission means exported code is partial. Mixed-purpose unnamed functions may include other logic; no authentication semantics were changed or relied on.
No secret, runtime credential, session token or saved profile values are included. Only structural names and source anchors are reported.
No overall winner or 100% isolation claim. SocialBox explicitly records unverified/gap rows and actual foreign-filesystem failures; SocialBox runtime isolation is not measured here.
The 23 categories are a bounded adoption inventory, not an exhaustive entire-binary audit; no non-use claim is based solely on a missing string.
priorityFindings: Keychain authority is architecturally different: SocialBox service interception and context-dependent rewriting versus SocialBox generated entitlements/compiled per-app alias mapping. Preserve current validated behavior while resolving service authority.

SocialBox broad SecItemDelete forwarding branch, cookie name-only inspected branch, and shared media service globals deserve negative-scope tests before reuse; these are static review leads, not reproduced vulnerabilities.
Promising ports are supplementary caller-bound LSD/media-service measurement/policy and lifecycle diagnostics; copying all service hooks wholesale would change the security boundary.
scope: Bounded static identifier/storage review of SocialBox3.1.0-1 reconstructed pseudocode against current SocialBox ledger. No original buildable source supplied; no execution, runtime data access, authentication changes, repository edits or installation.
